meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按技能步骤，通过 Microsoft Graph 创建和管理 Entra Agent Identity（Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、每个实例的 Agent Identity），并配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换与权限授权。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建 Agent Identity Blueprint、配置 agent OAuth 或 fmi_path 令牌交换等时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Agent Identity Blueprint
say.note: Claude 会调用 Graph API 创建蓝图对象。

say.text: 为我的 agent 配置 fmi_path 令牌交换
say.note: Claude 会按两步骤完成令牌交换配置。

say.text: 创建 BlueprintPrincipal 并授予 User.Read.All
say.note: Claude 会创建主体并授权应用权限。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the skill's steps to create and manage Entra Agent Identities (Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, per-instance Agent Identity) via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange and permission grants.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create an Agent Identity Blueprint, configure agent OAuth, or set up fmi_path token exchange.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint for me.
say_en.note: Claude calls Graph API to create it.

say_en.text: Set up fmi_path token exchange for my agent.
Create a BlueprintPrincipal and grant User.Read.All.
say_en.note: Claude creates the principal and grants the app permission.
